chapter.verse: Ute naute aw, i pute in meii nuai-ah a om uh a, San Tuipi laizang a kantan uh ahi zongin,
a vekpi-un meii leh tuipi sungah Moses’ baptaizna a ngah uh ahi zongin,
a vekpi-un kha an a nekhawm uh ahi zongin,

kha tawh kipawl tui a dawnkhawm uh ahi zongin, note in thei loin na om ding uh ka deih kei hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, tuate khempeuh in amau nung a zui, kha tawh kipawl suangpi pan a luangkhia tui a dawn uh hi. Tua suangpi in Khazih ahi hi.
Ahih hangin Pasian in amaute lakah a tampite tungah a lungkim kei a, gampa lakah a sigawp uh hi.
Amaute in a hoih lote a deihgawh uh bangin i deihgawh loh nadingin hih thute in eite adingin lim kilahna ahi hi.
“Mite in an ne, tui dawnin a tu uh a, a nung ciangin laam dingin a ding uh hi,” ci-in a kigelh mah bangin tuate kimkhat in milim a biak uh mah bangin bia kei ni.
Tuate in numei leh pasal mawhna bawl uh a, nikhat sunga mi thennih le tulthum tak a sih uh bangin numei leh pasal mawhna hih kei ni.
Tuate kimkhat in Topa a ze-et uh a, gul in a sukgawp bangin eite in Pasian ze-et loin om ni.
Tuate kimkhat in kihhuaina a bawl uh a, a susia vantungmi’ khut sungah a kisiat uh bangin eite in kihhuaina bawl kei ni.
Tua thu khempeuh in limlahna ahih nadingin tuate tungah a na tung hi. Leitung khang a nunung bela piang eite hong kihilh nadingin a kigelh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ka lungkip hi ci-in a ki-um mi in a puk loh nadingin kikem hen.

Mi in a thuak theih loh ze-etna khat beek na thuak kei uh hi. Pasian in thumanna lungsim tawh kidim ahih ciangin na thuak zawh loh uh ze-etna hong tun’ nadingin thu a pia kei ding hi. Note in na thuak ding uh ze-etna a hong tun’sak ciangin na thuak zawh nadingun suahtak nading lampi zong hong bawlsak ding hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ka itte aw, milim biakna na taisan un.
Lungpil mi kiangah ka gen mah bangin note kiangah kong gen hi. Ka thu na ngaihsun un.
Eite in hehpihna i phatna thupha’ hai in Khazih’ si tawh kizopna hilo ahi hiam? Eite balnen khomun in Khazih’ pumpi tawh kizopna hilo ahi hiam?
Khomun pumkhat bek om a, eite khempeuh in pumkhat bek i hi a, tua khomun zomin i ne ahih ciangin a tampi ahi eite in pumkhat bek i hi hi.
Ci-le-sa lamsangah Israelte na en ta un. Biakna sa a nete in biakna tau tawh kipawl hilo ahi uh hiam?
Tua bang ka cihna in bang ka cihnopna ahi hiam? Milim ahi a, milim biakna sa ahi zongin thupi hi a ci nuam ka hi hiam?
Tua bang ahi kei hi. Gentailte’ biakna in Pasian a biakna uh hi loin, dawigilote a biakna uh ahi hi. Note dawigilote tawh na kipawl ding uh ka deih kei hi.
Topa’ hai leh dawigilote’ hai na dawnkhawm zo kei ding uh hi. Topa’ sabuai leh dawigilote’ sabuai-ah an na nekhawm zo kei ding uh hi.
Ahih kei leh, Topa’ heh nadingin phin ding i hi hiam? Amah sangin hatzaw i hi hiam?
Na khempeuh i bawl theih hangin na khempeuh hih ding a kilawm kei hi. Thu khempeuh i hih theih hangin thu khempeuh in hong kipsak thei kei uh hi.
Ama noptuamna bek kuamah in zong kei hen; midangte’ noptuamna zong hen.
Kitheihna lungsim tawh ngaihsunin sumbuka kizuak khempeuh teldot loin na ne un.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, leitung leh leitung-ah a om khempeuh in Topa’ aa ahi hi.
A um lote khat in no hong vaak dingin hong sam a, na hawh nop uh leh, kitheihna lungsim tawh ngaihsunin na mai uhah hong kilui khempeuh teldot loin na ne un.
Ahi zongin mikhat in, “Hihte milim biakna sa ahi hi,” ci-in hong gen leh, tua hong lak mi na khualna uh leh kitheihna lungsim tawh ngaihsunin na ne kei un.

Kitheihna lungsim ka cihna ah, nangma kitheih theihna lungsim ka cihna ahi kei hi. Ama kitheih theihna lungsim ka cihnopna hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, midangte’ kitheih theihna lungsim in bang hangin kei thu hong khen ding ahi hiam?
Lungdamna kohna tawh hehpihna phatin an ka nek leh, bang hangin gensiatna thuak ding ka hi hiam?
Tua ahih ciangin note in anneek tuidawn akipan na khempeuh na bawl uh ciangin Pasian’ minthan’ nading ngaihsunin na hih un.
Midang tampite in gupna a ngah nadingun kei in keima noptuamna zong loin

mi tampite’ noptuamna zongin, mi khempeuh’ deihna na khempeuh ah ka zuih bangin note in zong Judah mi ahi zongin, Grik mi ahi zongin Pasian’ pawlpi ahi zongin, tuate khempeuh a puk loh nadingun kikem un.
